name: Nissan
description: Nissan over a generic OBD-II dongle (HS-CAN, UDS/KWP). Tuned for the 2016 370Z NISMO (Z34, UK) AUDIO job -- finding the AV control unit that stores the Bose-amp fault codes (B1F00-49 'BOSE AMP', U1263 amp comms). The amp itself is not an addressable diagnostic node. Powertrain answers 0x7E0-0x7E7; body/comfort/AV modules answer on Nissan's 0x74x block (response = request + 0x20). The exact AV-unit id is UNVERIFIED, so the profile discovers live which addresses answer.

panel.title: All modules (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Module scan for CAN-era Nissans (Z34 370Z and siblings) over the ordinary OBD dongle — each module's own fault memory, deeper than generic OBD-II. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan. The AV/head unit that holds the Bose-amp codes is on Nissan's 0x74x body block; its exact address is discovered live.

actions.title: Nissan module sweep
actions.hint: Fast read-only sweep of the powertrain (0x7E0-0x7E7) and Nissan body/AV (0x74x) candidate addresses — reports which nodes answer so you can find the AV unit that stores the Bose-amp codes. Then read its DTCs (nissan_audio_faults) — targets the symptom: audio to rear speakers only, none to the front door/dash speakers (B1F00-49 'BOSE AMP', U1263).
